 ALLPOWERS Black Friday 2026 — Terms & Conditions 
 Review the campaign period, order-value savings, gifts and other benefits for ALLPOWERS US. Check the conditions displayed in your cart and at checkout before purchasing.
 1. Campaign period and timing
 The ALLPOWERS US Black Friday campaign page lists four phases from November 3 through December 4, 2026. Phase dates are calendar dates; please check the current campaign page and checkout for the precise start or end time and applicable time zone before placing an order.
 2. Where the offers apply
 The benefits described here relate to participating products and orders on the ALLPOWERS US online store. Prices, variants, bundles and stock may differ. Product-specific eligibility and any additional benefit must be checked on the product page and in the cart or checkout. Offers are subject to product availability.
 3. The four campaign phases
 November 3–8: Black Friday Preview.
 November 9–19: Early Black Friday; additional phase benefits are not listed as confirmed on the current campaign page.
 November 20–26: Black Week; the gifts shown on the campaign page are offered only during this phase.
 November 27–December 4: Black Friday Finale; additional phase benefits are not listed as confirmed on the current campaign page.
 Benefits for one phase do not apply retrospectively or automatically carry over to orders placed in another phase.
 4. Extra savings by order value
 For the Preview phase, the current campaign page lists 5% off orders of $1,000 USD+, 7% off $1,500 USD+ and 12% off $2,500 USD+. For Black Week (November 20–26), it lists 5% off $1,000 USD+, 7% off $1,500 USD+ and 10% off $2,500 USD+. Extra savings for the Early and Finale phases are not confirmed on the current campaign page and are not promised here.
 These percentage tiers are alternatives, not cumulative discounts. Check the cart and checkout for eligible items, the order value used to determine the threshold and the actual discount applied. A sale price on a product card does not by itself guarantee an additional discount.
 5. Free gifts during Black Week only
 The campaign page lists the following gift tiers for November 20–26: orders of $1,200 USD+ — ALLPOWERS SP001 5V 21W foldable solar panel; $1,600 USD+ — P100 Power Bank; $2,200 USD+ — SE60 60W solar panel; $3,200 USD+ — VOLIX P300 Power Station. The actual gift shown during the phase and its availability take precedence.
 A gift is confirmed as free only when it appears in the order at $0 or with an equivalent full discount. Check the qualifying order value and gift displayed in your cart and at checkout. These gift tiers do not apply outside Black Week.
 6. Rewards and points
 Members may earn points on eligible purchases and redeem available rewards under the current ALLPOWERS US Rewards terms shown in their account. A promotional points multiplier is not confirmed for the Early or Finale phase on the current campaign page, so no multiplier is promised in these terms. Earning, posting, redemption and combination with discounts depend on the applicable rewards rules.
 7. Prices, discount codes and checkout
 Check the final total, including applicable discounts, shipping charges and sales tax, at checkout. Sale prices, order-value savings, individual codes and rewards cannot necessarily be combined; a combination applies only if it is actually accepted at checkout. An unavailable or expired offer cannot be applied retrospectively to an earlier order.
 8. Shipping and pre-orders
 Shipping areas, charges and estimated dispatch dates are shown on the relevant product page or before you place an order. A dispatch date shown for a pre-order is an estimate; read any separate pre-order notice before purchasing. Items in the same order may ship at different times.
 9. Cancellations, returns and warranty
 Cancellations, returns and warranty matters are handled under the policies published on the US store and applicable law. If an order with an order-value benefit is cancelled or returned, eligibility for that benefit may change; the applicable policy and circumstances of the order determine the outcome. Rights provided by applicable law are not affected.
 10. Changes, interpretation and questions
 Current campaign information will be published on the official campaign page if an offer changes. ALLPOWERS administers the campaign and can explain how these terms apply to an individual case on request. Interpretation is subject to applicable law, and rights provided by law remain unaffected. Contact ALLPOWERS US customer service with questions about an offer or order before purchasing.

 ALLPOWERS Black Friday 2025: What the Sale Actually Looked Like 
 ALLPOWERS announced its 2025 Black Friday sale through its own PR Newswire press release, dated November 24, 2025, titled “ALLPOWERS Launches Biggest Black Friday Sale.” Here’s what it actually said:
 Headline discount: up to 68% off, running from mid-November through December 1, 2025 (the release didn’t give an exact start date).
 Products covered: the R2500, R1500 and R1500 Lite series, the R600 series, the R4000, plus the SP037 and SP039 solar panels and power-station-plus-solar bundles. No individual per-model prices were listed in the release.
 Tiered sitewide discounts on top of the headline sale (in euros): an extra 3% off orders over €1,200, 5% off over €1,600, 7% off over €2,000, and 10% off over €2,500.
 Free gifts by order size (in euros): a free PB100 power bank on orders over €1,700, a Solax P100 over €2,100, an S200 over €2,500, and a free R600 unit over €3,000.
 The release’s figures are in euros, which suggests the tiered-discount and free-gift structure was built for the EU market specifically — a US buyer may see a different structure. No promo code was mentioned for the headline discount.
 ALLPOWERS Black Friday 2026: What to Expect This Year 
 We won’t invent a 2026 number before ALLPOWERS publishes one. But the 2025 pattern is a useful guide: ALLPOWERS stacked three separate discount layers rather than one flat percentage — a headline sitewide/category discount (up to 68% in 2025), an extra spend-tiered discount that grows with order size, and a free-gift tier that also grows with order size. If 2026 follows the same shape, the better value usually isn’t the headline percentage alone — it’s reaching the next spend tier, since that can add a free accessory on top of the percentage cut.
 Picking the Right ALLPOWERS Series for Black Friday 
 ALLPOWERS sells several unrelated product lines under one storefront, so match the deal to what you actually need before chasing the biggest percentage off. The R-series (R600 through R4000) are portable power stations sized by watt-hour capacity — R600 and R1500 for weekend camping and small appliances, R2500 and R4000 for home backup or multi-day off-grid use. Solar panels like the SP037/SP039 only pay off the “free electricity” part of the pitch if you’re regularly somewhere sunny for long enough to recharge a station fully — otherwise you’re paying extra for a panel that mostly sits unused. ALLPOWERS also sells its own line of small appliances, a separate discount tier that has nothing to do with the power stations.
 How to Check an ALLPOWERS Black Friday Deal Is Real 
 Check the exact model number and watt-hour capacity against ALLPOWERS’ own site before comparing prices — the R-series naming has grown into several similarly named variants (R1500 vs R1500 Lite, for example), and a lower price can simply mean a smaller or older variant, not a better deal.  Questions and answers
 When does ALLPOWERS run sales? ALLPOWERS discounts most around Black Friday, Prime Day and other major retail events, and it runs direct-site promotions through the year. Prices on the larger stations move the most, so check the price history before buying. 
 Which ALLPOWERS products are best? The R4000 suits whole-home backup and the R1500 covers most camping and RV needs at 1800W output. The VOLIX P300 is the light choice for phones and laptops, and the SP033 200W panel pairs with the larger stations. 
 What is ALLPOWERS' return policy? Orders bought directly from ALLPOWERS can be returned within 30 days of delivery if the item is unused and in its original packaging. Amazon and other marketplace orders follow that seller's return terms instead. 
 Do ALLPOWERS power stations work with solar panels from other brands? Yes, if the panel's voltage and connector match the station's solar input. ALLPOWERS' own SP033 and SP001 panels plug in directly, and the MC4 adapter covers most third-party panels within the input limits. 
 What warranty does ALLPOWERS offer? ALLPOWERS backs its power stations with a manufacturer warranty, and the LiFePO4 models such as the R4000 and R1500 carry longer coverage than the small panels. Keep the order confirmation, since claims go through the seller you bought from. 
 What can the R4000 power? The R4000 runs high-draw appliances and whole-home backup loads, and its LiFePO4 battery is built for frequent charge cycles. It recharges from AC, solar or a car input, and pairs with the SP033 200W panel for off-grid use. 
 Which ALLPOWERS solar panels fold for travel? The SP037 400W, SP039 600W and SP001 21W are foldable panels built to pack down for camping and van trips. The SE100 and SE200 are laminated integrated panels, which suit semi-permanent mounting on a roof or shed rather than folding away. 
 What is the difference between the R3500 V2 and the R2500 V2? The R3500 V2 delivers 3500W from a 2880Wh battery, while the R2500 V2 is the smaller station in the same V2 line. Both use LiFePO4 cells and recharge from AC or solar. The R3500 V2 suits heavier backup loads; the R2500 V2 is easier to move between rooms and vehicles.
